events.title: US-Iran War Active ~6 Months
events.summary: US-Iran war ongoing since ~Feb 2026. US naval blockade of Iran, 'crushing economic operation', missile threats, Trump threatens military action against Oman. Iran shifting to 'fully offensive' posture.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz Closure - Biggest Global Energy Disruption
events.summary: Tehran effectively closed Strait of Hormuz in retaliation for US/Israeli strikes. Brent ~$89 (was $107 in May). Global oil stockpiles rapidly diminishing. IEA confirms supply chain disruption. ~20M bbl/day normally transits.

events.title: Coordinated US/Japan/Korea FX Interventions
events.summary: Rare joint US-Japan yen intervention ($34-59B). South Korea/US/Japan unprecedented joint intervention (won 9-month high). India rupee near record lows with RBI intervention. Asia-wide currency defense.

events.title: 5th US Bank Failure of 2026
events.summary: Tioga-Franklin Savings Bank (Philadelphia) failed Aug 21 - 5th US bank failure of 2026. Drip of small-bank closures continues amid tight liquidity.

events.title: China Property Crisis - 5-Year Downward Spiral
events.summary: China property market in 5-year downward spiral. Developer defaults, 'stable contraction' of property values, households forced to sell. PBOC pledges timely policy adjustment.

events.title: Largest Ebola Outbreak in DRC History
events.summary: Bundibugyo virus epidemic in DRC - largest Ebola outbreak ever documented in the country, exceeding 2018-2020 (3,317 cases). WHO IHR Emergency Committee met Aug 18.

events.title: Africa Debt Crisis Deepening
events.summary: Egypt secured extra $1.8B IMF loan (most indebted to IMF). Senegal on the brink, IMF/World Bank pushing restructuring. Africa-wide debt crisis entering 2026.
